title: The Paycheck Replacement Math Without Selling Stocks
hook_text: REPLACE A $50,000 PAYCHECK WITHOUT SELLING STOCKS

beats.say: To replace a $50,000 paycheck, you don't need a million dollars in cash.
beats.visual: A worn leather wallet sitting on a dark wooden table in soft morning light.

beats.say: You need a targeted net yield calculation instead of blind saving.
beats.visual: A hand placing a single heavy brass key next to an open notebook.

beats.say: Most people assume you must liquidate your stock portfolio to cover monthly bills.
beats.visual: A digital stock ticker blurred in the background behind a stack of coins.

beats.say: That strategy triggers heavy capital gains taxes and shrinks your capital fast.
beats.visual: Red ink spreading slowly across a blank ledger page.

beats.say: How do you generate steady cash flow without ever selling a single share?
beats.visual: A close-up of a fountain pen hovering over a blank line.

beats.say: Take $2,000 of passive income each month as a baseline target.
beats.visual: A ceramic coffee cup steaming on a rustic oak desk.

beats.say: That specific level needs about $600,000 invested under the 4% rule.
beats.visual: A calculator screen glowing in a dimly lit home office.

beats.say: Investing $500 a month at 8% a year reaches that target in 27.6 years.
beats.visual: A wall calendar with pages slowly fluttering in a gentle breeze.

beats.say: Or investing $2,000 a month at 8% a year hits it in 13.8 years.
beats.visual: A modern wristwatch resting on a folded wool sweater.

beats.say: The honest catch is the upfront discipline required to fund those accounts.
beats.visual: A heavy metal door half open to a bright hallway.

beats.say: Build your yield before you quit your job.
beats.visual: A hand closing a heavy ledger book on a dark desk.

beats.say: Follow for the money rules school never taught you.
beats.visual: A sharp minimalist logo centered on a textured dark background.
